sentence_stem: She said that she was tired,
correct_completion: so she wanted to go home early.
full_sentence: She said that she was tired, so she wanted to go home early.
acceptable_variants: so she decided to leave the party.
so she asked if she could go home.

options.text: so she wanted to go home early.
she will go home early tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This uses a future form that does not match the reported statement, and it does not explain the reason introduced by the stem.

options.text: but she was feeling very energetic.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the reported statement that she was tired.

options.text: she has been tired since Monday.
options.why_wrong: This adds time information but does not complete the link between being tired and wanting to leave.

grammar_focus: Reported speech with a result clause
explanation: In reported speech the first clause reports what the person said, and the second clause should give the logical result of that statement. Learners whose first language uses a different word order for reported clauses sometimes place the result in the wrong position, so check that the completion follows from the first clause.
translation: Yorgun olduğunu söyledi, bu yüzden erken eve gitmek istedi.
